mapper.select: SELECT a.application_id,a.environment,(d.membership_id IS NOT NULL) management FROM auth_governance.tenant_application a JOIN auth_governance.application_catalog c ON c.application_id=a.application_id AND c.manifest_version > 0 LEFT JOIN auth_governance.access_delegation d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.application_id=a.application_id AND d.environment=a.environment AND d.membership_id=#{member} AND d.generation=#{generation} AND d.enabled WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.enabled AND (a.application_id,a.environment) > (#{application},#{environment}) AND (d.membership_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.access_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND g.application_id=a.application_id AND g.environment=a.environment AND ((g.membership_id=#{member} AND g.generation=#{generation}) OR (g.source_type='GROUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_group_member gm WHERE gm.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND gm.group_id=g.group_id AND gm.membership_id=#{member} AND gm.generation=#{generation} AND gm.current))))) ORDER BY a.application_id,a.environment LIMIT 21
